At bestemme hvem der danner regering og: To decide who forms the government and to control the government (e.g. by demanding answers from ministers).
Hvad betyder det, at Danmark er et parla: What does it mean that Denmark is a parliamentary democracy?
At en regering ikke kan udnævnes, hvis e: That a government cannot be appointed if a majority in the Folketing is against it. The Folketing decides who holds governmental power.
Hvad kan der ske, hvis en regering får f: What can happen if a government finds the majority against it on an important matter (e.g. the budget)?
Regeringen kan gå af eller udskrive valg: The government can resign or call an election.
Har Danmark et overhus, der skal godkend: Does Denmark have an upper house that must approve the Folketing's decisions?
Er Folketingets møder åbne for almindeli: Are the Folketing's meetings open to ordinary citizens?
Ja, møderne er normalt offentlige. Man k: Yes, the meetings are normally public. You can also follow them on TV and on the Folketing's website.
Hvornår er der spørgetid i Folketinget?: When is question time in the Folketing?
Hver onsdag – ministre svarer på spørgsm: Every Wednesday – ministers answer questions from members of the Folketing.
Hvor mange behandlinger skal et lovforsl: How many readings must a bill have in the Folketing?
Three readings before it can be passed.
Faste udvalg, der nogenlunde svarer til: Standing committees that roughly correspond to the ministries. They deal with bills between the three readings and put questions to the minister.
Hvad arbejder Retsudvalget og Europaudva: What do the Legal Affairs Committee and the European Affairs Committee work on?
Legal Affairs Committee: police, courts and punishment. European Affairs Committee: Denmark's relationship with the EU.
Kan borgere og foreninger kontakte Folke: Can citizens and associations contact the Folketing's committees and members?
Ja. De kan skrive, e-maile eller ringe o: Yes. They can write, email or call and ask for a meeting. Citizens can also freely write to members of the Folketing.
Hvilken magt har regeringen ud over at v: What power does the government have besides being part of the legislative power?
Den udøvende magt – regeringen og myndig: The executive power – the government and the authorities implement and administer the laws through the ministries.
Hvem kommer med langt de fleste lovforsl: Who puts forward by far the most bills?
Hvem leder regeringen, og hvor mange min: Who leads the government, and how many ministers are there normally?
Statsministeren. Normalt ca. 20 ministre: The prime minister. Normally about 20 ministers.
Hvem bestemmer, hvem der skal være minis: Who decides who will be a minister, and how many there will be?
Skal ministre være medlem af Folketinget: Do ministers have to be members of the Folketing?
Som regel er de det, men de behøver ikke: They usually are, but they do not have to be.
Hvem bestemmer, at ministerier lægges sa: Who decides that ministries are merged or created?
Statsministeren (som regel efter et folk: The prime minister (usually after a general election).
Hvem er ansvarlig for, hvad der foregår: Who is responsible for what goes on in a ministry?
En regering, hvor flere partier sammen h: A government in which several parties hold governmental power together.
Hvad er forskellen på en flertalsregerin: What is the difference between a majority government and a minority government?
Flertalsregering: regeringspartierne har: Majority government: the government parties together have a majority in the Folketing. Minority government: they do not have a majority and depend on support from other parties.
Hvad kaldes partier uden for regeringen,: What are parties outside the government that support a minority government called?
De politiske partier, der har ministre i: The political parties that have ministers in the government.
Hvilken type regering har de fleste dans: What type of government have most Danish governments since 1945 been?
Hvilke fire partier består den nuværende: Which four parties make up the current government?
Socialdemokratiet, SF, Moderaterne og Ra: The Social Democrats, SF (Socialist People's Party), the Moderates and the Social Liberals (Radikale Venstre).
Folket vælger politikere til Folketinget: The people elect politicians to the Folketing, who take care of legislation on the people's behalf.
Hvor mange folkeafstemninger har der vær: How many referendums have there been since the 1953 Constitution, and how many were about the EU?
16 folkeafstemninger. Ni af dem handlede: 16 referendums. Nine of them were about Denmark's relationship with the EU.
Hvad hedder den folkevalgte forsamling i: What is the elected assembly called in a municipality and in a region?
Kommune: kommunalbestyrelse. Region: reg: Municipality: municipal council (kommunalbestyrelse). Region: regional council (regionsråd).
Hvert fjerde år (2017, 2021, 2025 osv.): Every fourth year (2017, 2021, 2025, etc.) – at the same time.
Hvad er tanken med det lokale selvstyre?: What is the idea behind local self-government?
At offentlige opgaver, der har med borge: That public tasks related to citizens' daily lives are handled as close to the citizens as possible.
Hvad kan man få hjælp til hos kommunens: What can you get help with at the municipality's citizen service (borgerservice)?
Svar på spørgsmål og praktiske ting, fx: Answers to questions and practical matters, e.g. moving house, pensions, passports and driving licences.
Hvilke opgaver har kommunerne ansvar for: Which tasks are the municipalities responsible for?
Vuggestuer, børnehaver, folkeskoler, hjæ: Nurseries, kindergartens, folkeskoler, help for the elderly and disabled, employment, integration, roads, waste, environment, leisure and cultural activities.
Hvad kaldes formanden for kommunalbestyr: What is the chair of the municipal council called, and who elects them?
Borgmesteren (i København: overborgmeste: The mayor (borgmester; in Copenhagen: the Lord Mayor, overborgmester). Elected by the newly elected municipal council.
Hvor mange medlemmer har en kommunalbest: How many members does a municipal council have?
Typisk 19–31 (ned til 9 i de mindste kom: Typically 19–31 (down to 9 in the smallest municipalities, up to 55 in Copenhagen). Always an odd number.
Har kommunerne ret til at udskrive skatt: Do the municipalities have the right to levy taxes?
Ja. Staten giver også penge til kommuner: Yes. The state also gives money to the municipalities.
Hvad hedder kommunernes interesseorganis: What is the municipalities' interest organisation called?
Kommunernes Landsforening (KL). Regering: Local Government Denmark (Kommunernes Landsforening, KL). Every year the government makes an economic agreement with KL.
Hvor mange regioner er der i Danmark, og: How many regions are there in Denmark, and what are they called?
Fem: Hovedstaden, Sjælland, Syddanmark,: Five: the Capital Region, Zealand, Southern Denmark, Central Jutland and North Jutland.
Hvad sker der med Region Hovedstaden og: What happens to the Capital Region and Region Zealand on 1 January 2027?
They merge into Region East Denmark (Region Østdanmark).
Hvad har regionerne bl.a. ansvar for?: What are the regions responsible for, among other things?
Sundhedsområdet – de driver de offentlig: Healthcare – they run the public hospitals.
Har regionerne ret til at udskrive skatt: Do the regions have the right to levy taxes?
Nej. De får deres penge direkte fra stat: No. They get their money directly from the state.
Hvem leder en region, og hvad hedder reg: Who leads a region, and what is the regions' interest organisation called?
Et regionsråd med en regionsrådsformand: A regional council with a chair (elected by the regional council). Interest organisation: Danish Regions (Danske Regioner).
Hvilke fire valg afholdes der i Danmark?: Which four elections are held in Denmark?
Folketingsvalg, kommunalvalg, regionsråd: General (Folketing) elections, municipal elections, regional council elections and elections to the European Parliament.
Hvad er de fire politiske niveauer?: What are the four political levels?
Lokalt: kommunalbestyrelsen. Regionalt:: Local: the municipal council. Regional: the regional council. National: the Folketing. EU: the European Parliament.
Om helt konkrete ting, fx valgretsaldere: On very specific matters, e.g. the voting age or when Denmark is to give up sovereignty (e.g. EU membership).
Hvem udskriver folketingsvalg, og hvor o: Who calls a general election, and how often must there be an election at least?
Statsministeren. Der skal være valg mind: The prime minister. There must be an election at least every fourth year.
Hvilke tre krav skal man opfylde for at: Which three requirements must you meet to vote in a general election?
Dansk statsborgerskab, fyldt 18 år og fa: Danish citizenship, being 18 or older and permanent residence in Denmark, the Faroe Islands or Greenland.
Nej. Men ca. 85 % stemmer normalt til fo: No. But about 85% normally vote in general elections.
Hvor stor var valgdeltagelsen til kommun: What was voter turnout in the 2025 municipal and regional elections, and in the 2024 European Parliament election?
Hvem må stemme til kommunal- og regionsv: Who may vote in municipal and regional elections?
Fyldt 18 år – ikke krav om dansk statsbo: Anyone 18 or older – Danish citizenship is not required. Also citizens of the EU, Norway and Iceland with permanent residence, and other foreigners who have lived permanently in Denmark for the four years before election day.
Hvad betyder valgbar?: What does eligible for election (valgbar) mean?
At man kan vælges. Opfylder man betingel: That you can be elected. If you meet the conditions for voting, you are normally also eligible for election.
Hvordan fordeler Folketingets 179 medlem: How are the Folketing's 179 members distributed?
175 valgt i Danmark + 2 fra Færøerne + 2: 175 elected in Denmark + 2 from the Faroe Islands + 2 from Greenland.
Hvor stor en andel af de valgte til Folk: What share of those elected to the Folketing in 2026 are women?
Hvor stor en andel af kommunalbestyrelse: What share of municipal council and regional council members are women?
Kommunalbestyrelser: ca. 36 %. Regionsrå: Municipal councils: about 36%. Regional councils: about 50%.
Hvor mange medlemmer er der i hvert regi: How many members are there on each regional council?
41 (ifølge fakta-ark 15; fakta-ark 14 næ: 41 (according to fact sheet 15; fact sheet 14 mentions 25–47).
Hvor ofte er der valg til Europa-Parlame: How often are there elections to the European Parliament, and how many members does Denmark elect?
Hvert femte år (2019, 2024, 2029 …). Dan: Every fifth year (2019, 2024, 2029 …). Denmark elects 15 members.
Hvem har valgret til Europa-Parlamentsva: Who has the right to vote in the European Parliament election in Denmark?
Statsborgere i et EU-land, der er fyldt: Citizens of an EU country who are 18 or older.
Hvad er et valgkort, og hvad skal man gø: What is a polling card (valgkort), and what must you do if you do not bring it?
Bevis på stemmeret med oplysninger om hv: Proof of your right to vote, with information about where and when to vote. Without a polling card you must bring ID.
Hvad betyder hemmelig afstemning?: What does a secret ballot mean?
At ingen andre må se, hvad eller hvem ma: That no one else may see what or whom you vote for.
Hvordan stemmer man på stemmesedlen?: How do you vote on the ballot paper?
Sæt kryds ved et parti eller en bestemt: Put a cross next to a party or a specific candidate. You can also cast a blank vote (no cross, often as a protest).
Hvad er brevstemme?: What is a postal / advance vote (brevstemme)?
At stemme inden valgdagen – kan gøres al: Voting before election day – can be done anywhere in the country and at Danish embassies and missions abroad.
En forening, der arbejder for et bestemt: An association that works for a particular political programme and puts up candidates for election.
En folketingspolitiker uden for partiern: A member of the Folketing outside the parties (e.g. after leaving their party). The politician does not have to leave the Folketing.
Hvilke partier fik flest stemmer ved fol: Which parties got the most votes in the 2026 general election (top three)?
The Social Democrats, SF and Venstre.
Hvor mange danskere er medlem af et poli: How many Danes are members of a political party, and how are the parties financed?
Ca. 106.000 medlemmer. Penge fra konting: About 106,000 members. Money from membership fees and from the state in proportion to the number of votes.
En sammenslutning af personer eller virk: An association of people or companies with a common interest (e.g. a trade union, patients' association, farmers' organisation) that tries to influence politics.
Mindre formelt organiseret end en intere: Less formally organised than an interest organisation – its strength comes from its participants' activity. Uses, for example, petitions and demonstrations.
Skal man have tilladelse til at demonstr: Do you need permission to demonstrate?
No – but you must notify the police. The police can require the demonstration to move and can only ban it in very special circumstances.
Hvad er den mest almindelige form for pr: What is the most common form of protest among grassroots movements?
Hvilke tre slags rettigheder har borgern: What three kinds of rights do citizens have?
Politiske rettigheder, frihedsrettighede: Political rights, civil liberties and social rights.
Retten til at stemme og til at opstille: The right to vote and to stand as a candidate (Folketing, municipal council).
Hvilke fire frihedsrettigheder nævnes?: Which four civil liberties are mentioned?
Religionsfrihed, ytringsfrihed, forsamli: Freedom of religion, freedom of speech, freedom of assembly and freedom of association.
Retten til ydelser og tilbud, hvis man h: The right to benefits and services if you need help – e.g. free medical care or financial support.
The duty to pay tax and conscription (military service).
Hvad skal man betale skat af?: What do you have to pay tax on?
Løn, mange sociale ydelser, SU, renter i: Wages, many social benefits, SU, interest in the bank, gains from selling shares – and in some cases gifts.
Alle mænd og kvinder over 18 år med dans: All men and women over 18 with Danish citizenship. Women have only been subject to conscription since 1 July 2025.
Alle bliver indkaldt til tests og helbre: Everyone is called in for tests and a health check. About half are declared fit. Then everyone draws a lottery number.
Hvor længe varer værnepligten?: How long does military service last?
Normalt 11 måneder i Forsvaret og ni mån: Normally 11 months in the Armed Forces and nine months in the Emergency Management Agency.
Hvad kan man gøre, hvis man vil nægte at: What can you do if you want to refuse military service in the Armed Forces or the Emergency Management Agency?
Søge militærnægterordningen og aftjene s: Apply for conscientious objector status and do your service e.g. in public institutions or relief organisations.
Hvor mange værnepligtige skal der være p: How many conscripts should there eventually be (decided in 2024)?
Hvornår blev religionsfriheden stadfæste: When was freedom of religion confirmed in Denmark?
Kan man skifte religion eller ikke have: Can you change religion or have no religion?
Ja – man kan frit skifte religion og kan: Yes – you can freely change religion and can choose to have none at all.
Hvilken kirke er den danske folkekirke i: According to the Constitution, which church is the Danish national church (folkekirken)?
Hvornår brød Danmark med den katolske ki: When did Denmark break with the Catholic Church?
Er stat og kirke adskilt i Danmark?: Are state and church separated in Denmark?
Nej. Staten understøtter folkekirken øko: No. The state supports the national church financially – but the church has no political power.
Hvor stor en andel er medlem af folkekir: What share are members of the national church (2026)?
Hvad bruger mange danskere folkekirken t: What do many Danes use the national church for?
Dåb, konfirmation, bryllup og begravelse: Baptism, confirmation, weddings and funerals – and quite a few go to church on Christmas Eve, 24 December.
Hvad er kirkeskat, og hvem betaler den?: What is church tax, and who pays it?
Betales af medlemmer af folkekirken til: Paid by members of the national church for the upkeep of churches and churchyards. Non-members do not pay it.
Hvordan bliver man medlem af folkekirken: How do you become a member of the national church?
Kun ved at blive døbt. Man kan frit meld: Only by being baptised. You can freely leave.
Ja, hvis den man skal giftes med er medl: Yes, if the person you are marrying is a member.
Hvem kan blive begravet på en dansk kirk: Who can be buried in a Danish churchyard?
Alle – også ikke-medlemmer af folkekirke: Everyone – including non-members of the national church. The funeral can be religious or civil.
Hvilke opgaver har folkekirken ud over g: What tasks does the national church have besides church services?
Hvad får et anerkendt trossamfund af for: What advantages does a recognised religious community get?
Medlemmerne kan (med begrænsninger) træk: Members can (with limits) deduct contributions from their taxes, and the priest can be authorised to perform legally valid weddings.
Hvor mange anerkendte trossamfund og men: How many recognised religious communities and congregations are there in Denmark?
Hvor mange lande er med i EU, og hvor li: How many countries are in the EU, and where is the headquarters?
Hvor mange EU-lande har euroen, og har D: How many EU countries have the euro, and does Denmark have it?
21 of 27. Denmark has kept the krone.
Hvornår blev Danmark medlem af EU (denga: When did Denmark join the EU (then the EC)?
Danskerne stemte nej til Maastricht-trak: The Danes voted no to the Maastricht Treaty. Denmark then negotiated the Danish opt-outs.
Områder hvor Danmark ikke deltager i EU-: Areas where Denmark does not take part in EU cooperation – including the euro and justice cooperation (police, criminal law, asylum, immigration, divorce, custody).
Hvordan kan et forbehold afskaffes?: How can an opt-out be abolished?
After a new referendum in Denmark.
Hvornår blev forsvarsforbeholdet ophævet: When was the defence opt-out abolished, and by what majority?
EU-topmøder, hvor stats- og regeringsche: EU summits where heads of state and government (for Denmark the prime minister) adopt the EU's overall political guidelines.
Hvem deltager i Ministerrådet?: Who takes part in the Council of Ministers?
Ministre fra medlemslandenes regeringer: Ministers from the member states' governments for the relevant area (e.g. environment ministers at environment meetings).
Hvad er Europa-Kommissionen, og hvor man: What is the European Commission, and how many commissioners does each country have?
Hvert EU-land har én kommissær, som lede: Each EU country has one commissioner, who leads a policy area. Commissioners must work independently of their home country. Denmark's commissioner is Dan Jørgensen.
Hvad er EU-Domstolens rolle?: What is the role of the EU Court of Justice?
